cases.case_label: Retropseudogene (~500 bp) in exon 3 of ATP7A
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~500-bp retropseudogene (97.7% identical to a chr22 region) with >100-bp polyA and 16-bp TSD inserted in reverse orientation in ATP7A exon 3, introducing premature stop codons; RNA-seq/PCR showed markedly reduced ATP7A transcript. The mother is a mosaic carrier.
cases.quote: PCR and RNA-seq revealed a marked reduction in ATP7A transcript levels in the patient.
